{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# First, ensure sample_seq is numeric (it is)
data = data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
# Keep only the first (highest sample_seq) row per patient
deduplicated_data = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (sentinel)
valid_data = deduplicated_data[deduplicated_data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(valid_data)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline:.2f}")"}
